targets.rawSql: SELECT timestamp as "Time", equipment_id as "Equipment", line_id as "Line", alert_type as "Alert Type", severity as "Severity", temperature_c as "Temp °C", fault_code as "Fault Code" FROM alerts WHERE acknowledged = false ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', timestamp) as time, COUNT(*) as "LINE-A" FROM alerts WHERE line_id = 'LINE-A' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', timestamp) as time, COUNT(*) as "LINE-B" FROM alerts WHERE line_id = 'LINE-B' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', timestamp) as time, COUNT(*) as "LINE-C" FROM alerts WHERE line_id = 'LINE-C' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM alerts WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT line_id, ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp))) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) - 1, 0) / 3600)::numeric, 2) as mtbf_hours FROM alerts WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY line_id
SELECT line_id, COUNT(*) as count FROM alerts WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY line_id
